group_manifest.proof_strategy: Select the first disjunct, introduce variables and hypotheses, substitute or rewrite retval/nodes equalities, unfold the relevant case-lib result definition (and xizi_double_link_first_value for next variants), then establish the pure proposition and cancel the unchanged xizi_dll resource. Do not prove the diagnostics-only split goals and do not use the structurally harder second disjunct.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All eight witnesses select the first disjunct and reduce an initialized-empty-list observation to a pure return-value fact plus an unchanged xizi_dll resource; keeping the three next variants together preserves their identical first_value(nil) proof pattern.

Do not prove the diagnostics-only split goals and do not use the structurally harder second disjunct.

premise_discharge.retval_equalities: PreH1 for empty/head/len and PreH1 plus PreH3 for next variants reduce the result predicate to reflexive equality.
premise_discharge.list_equalities: PreH3 in each next variant rewrites nodes to nil, so first_value nodes computes to zero and the pre/post xizi_dll predicates coincide.
premise_discharge.spatial_resource: The left-disjunct precondition already contains exactly the xizi_dll resource required by the postcondition after equality rewriting.

proving_hints: Prefer the left disjunct before introducing entailment variables.
Use equality substitution and definition reduction before spatial cancellation.
The diagnostics split goals are hints only and must not be added as assigned witnesses.
